items.definition:
the quality of being variable
There is significant variability in the weather patterns.

the quality of being open to more than one interpretation
There was some ambiguity in his statement.

a person who studies human history
The archaeologist discovered ancient pottery.

an accumulation or increase
There was a buildup of traffic on the highway.

masculine (referring to a lesbian woman)
She had a very butch style, preferring trousers and short hair.

the faith, practice, and church order of the Roman Catholic Church.
Catholicism is one of the largest Christian denominations worldwide.

a hard silvery-white metallic element; a deep blue color.
The artist used a vibrant cobalt blue in her painting.

a coal miner; a ship carrying coal.
The collier emerged from the mine, covered in dust.

a naval rank; a title for the president of a yacht club.
The commodore gave the order to set sail.

a program that converts instructions into a machine-code or lower-level form.
The programmer used a new compiler to optimize the code.

a group of stars forming a recognizable pattern.
The Big Dipper is a well-known constellation.

an outline, especially of a curving or irregular figure or mass.
The artist carefully drew the contours of the human face.

a false belief or impression that is resistant to reason.
He suffered from the delusion that he was a king.

a reduction in the value of an asset over time.
The car's depreciation was significant in its first year.

dissatisfaction with one's circumstances; a state of unhappiness.
There was widespread discontent among the workers.

a distinguishing characteristic or feature
Creativity is the hallmark of a good artist.

excessive speed or urgency of movement or action
In her haste, she forgot her keys.

a person's natural tendency or urge to act or feel in a particular way
She showed an inclination for music at an early age.

a person who intrudes, especially into a building with criminal intent
The alarm system detected an intruder.

initial public offering
The company announced its plans for an IPO next year.

a device for launching a rocket, missile, or other object
The rocket launcher was prepared for takeoff.

the state of being in accordance with the law
The legality of the new policy was questioned.

the length of time for which a person, animal, or thing exists
The average lifespan of a dog is about 10 to 13 years.

qualities or attributes regarded as characteristic of men
The film explores themes of identity and masculinity.

the state of being a mother
She embraced motherhood with joy and dedication.

the striking of one body against another; musical instruments played by striking
He plays the percussion instruments in the orchestra.

the natural coloring matter of animal or plant tissue
Chlorophyll is the green pigment in plants.

an official who keeps records, especially of births, marriages, and deaths
You need to speak to the university registrar about your enrollment.

a long, narrow strap attached to a bridle; a means of control
The rider pulled on the reins to stop the horse.

shortage; insufficiency
There is a scarcity of clean water in some regions.

a reversal or delay in progress
The project suffered a major setback due to funding cuts.

a small, sharp-pointed nail; a course of action
He changed tack and decided to approach the problem differently.

a priest in the Church of England who is in charge of a parish
The vicar delivered a sermon on kindness.

the period of development from the onset of puberty to maturity
Adolescence is a time of significant change.

life after death
Many religions have beliefs about the afterlife.

a pungent gas
Ammonia is often used in cleaning products.

a person who believes in anarchy
The anarchist protested against all forms of government.

a short amusing story
He shared a funny anecdote about his childhood.

a rough edge or a whirring sound
The metal had a sharp burr.

the action of settling among and establishing control over the indigenous people of an area
The colonization of new lands had a profound impact on history.

A group of steroid hormones that promote the development and maintenance of female characteristics of the body.
Estrogen plays a key role in the female reproductive system.

Food, especially dried hay or straw, for livestock; material used for a particular purpose.
The old documents provided excellent fodder for the historian's research.

A fierce or angry stare; a strong, harsh light.
She gave him a fierce glare.

A person of a counterculture movement of the 1960s.
My grandparents were hippies in the 60s.

The action of inserting something.
The insertion of the key into the lock was difficult.

A framework or structure of crossed wood or metal strips
The rose climbed up the wooden lattice.

A defensive player in American football
The linebacker tackled the opposing player.

A person or company that advertises or promotes a product
The marketer developed a new campaign.

Playful misbehavior or trouble
The children were always getting into mischief.

The process of adapting something to modern needs or habits
The modernization of the factory improved efficiency.

The act of occupying or taking possession of a building or land
The hotel has a high occupancy rate.

A large payment of money
The insurance company made a large payout after the accident.

A person who buys something
The purchaser signed the contract.

the state or quality of being rare
The rarity of the stamp made it very valuable.

real estate; property
He works in commercial realty.

the showing of a film or television program; a test or examination
There will be a special screening of the new movie tonight.

a sudden severe or prolonged fall in the price, value, or amount of something
The company is experiencing a sales slump.

a person or thing that spins
The fishing lure had a small spinner.

the act or process of sucking
The vacuum cleaner uses suction to pick up dirt.

a person whose job is to survey land or buildings
The surveyor measured the boundaries of the property.

a person's or animal's nature, especially as it permanently affects their behavior
She has a calm temperament.

water that has been used in the home, in a business, or in industry, and that contains substances that are harmful to the environment
The factory treats its wastewater before releasing it.

a large, destructive fire that spreads quickly over woodland or brush
The dry conditions led to a massive wildfire.

a circular arrangement of flowers, leaves, or stems
She hung a festive wreath on the front door for the holidays.
